name: fork-and-publish-skill
description: Customizes an installed agent skill and ships it back upstream or as a versioned fork using qvr's edit/publish authoring loop. Use when a user wants to modify, customize, fork, release, or publish a qvr skill — e.g. "edit this skill", "publish my changes", "fork a skill to my own repo", "cut a v1.0.0 release of a skill", or "iterate on a skill and tag new versions". Covers qvr edit, diff, status, and publish (--fork --migrate --tag, --auto-commit, root vs nested layout), including the consume-mode round trip.
